search.description: Case-insensitive substring filter over a scout's display name and its skill name. A scout matches on either, so a person who knows the label and a caller who knows the identifier both find it. Omit for the whole fleet.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags, e.g. `revenue,on-call`. Returns the scouts carrying at least one of them. Values are normalized the same way stored tags are, so `On Call` matches `on-call`. Omit for the whole fleet.
